words.def: to decide which things are most important and do them first.
words.book: Regardless of what was going on in my personal life, I always prioritized my studies, and I think this will be a good indication of my performance at work.
uses: Email
We'll prioritize the hospital's UPS repair over routine maintenance visits this week.
Chat
too many tickets today — which ones should I prioritize?
Meeting
Let's prioritize collections from the three biggest customers.
dont: I put the important things in the first.
doo: I prioritize the most important tasks.

words.def: to find a solution to a problem, complaint or disagreement.
words.book: For example, a customer complained about a wrong price, but I was able to work with them to resolve the issue.
uses: Email
The issue with the invoice has been resolved; a corrected copy is attached.
Chat
resolved the battery alarm ✅ closing the ticket
Meeting
Our target is to resolve every service call within 24 hours.
dont: We solved the complain of the customer.

words.def: handling customers who are unhappy and trying to fix their problem.
words.book: I have worked for two years as a shopkeeper, and I enjoyed working with customers, even when dealing with complaints.
uses: Email
Our after-sales team is experienced in dealing with complaints quickly and politely.
Chat
dealing with an angry client rn 😤 the UPS tripped twice
Meeting
The key to dealing with complaints is to listen first, then offer a solution.
dont: I am good in dealing with the complains.
doo: I'm good at dealing with complaints.

words.def: being responsible for your actions and results, and accepting blame if things go wrong.
words.book: Accountability: taking ownership of your actions and being responsible for your own and your team's results in the workplace.
uses: Email
We need clear accountability for each site: one engineer per contract.
Chat
who's accountable for the late delivery? 🤔
Meeting
I take full accountability for the delay, and here's how we'll fix it.
dont: It is not my mistake, it is the store mistake.
doo: I take accountability for the delay.

words.def: to stay informed about the latest developments in something.
words.book: I keep up with my area of expertise by reading professional journals, attending seminars, and taking occasional classes, either online or in a traditional classroom.
uses: Email
Our engineers attend annual training to keep up with the latest lithium-ion technology.
Chat
hard to keep up with all these new inverter models 😅
Meeting
We need to keep up with competitors' prices on solar panels.
dont: I follow the new things in my field.
doo: I keep up with the latest developments in my field.

words.def: increased to four times the original amount.
words.book: Under my direction, the club has grown from 30 to over 100 members and quadrupled the number of places where students can volunteer.
uses: Email
Our solar sales have quadrupled since last year.
Chat
demand for batteries has literally quadrupled this summer 📈
Meeting
If we win this tender, our service revenue will quadruple.

upgrade.plain: My grades are good, this shows I am working hard.
upgrade.ar: درجاتي كويسة، ده بيبيّن إني بشتغل جامد
pro: I think my grades reflect my work.
My grades is showing my working.

upgrade.plain: It was very difficult, but I did it.
pro: It was very hard but I make it.
It was very difficult, but I did it.
It was not an easy feat, but I managed to succeed.
upgrade.why: ‎not an easy feat‎ و‎managed to‎ بيوصفوا نجاح بعد تعب.

upgrade.plain: I did two trainings in companies.
pro: I did two trainings in companies.
I have two internships under my belt.
I have always been a voracious reader.
upgrade.why: ‎too much‎ سلبية. ‎voracious reader‎ يعني بتحب القراية جدًا.

upgrade.plain: I learned to be responsible about my mistakes.
pro: I learned to be responsible about my mistakes.
I learned to carry my mistakes.
I learned how to take ownership of my actions.
upgrade.why: ‎take ownership of‎ أقوى، و‎responsible for‎ مش ‎about‎.

upgrade.plain: My grades are not showing my real level.
pro: My grades don't show my real level.
My grades are not necessarily a good indication of what I can achieve.
upgrade.why: ‎not necessarily a good indication‎ بتقولها بلباقة من غير تبرير.
